result.markdown:
Yes. I’d shortlist the following **Brisbane medical negligence lawyers/firms**, based on specialist recognition, peer rankings, and demonstrated medical-negligence experience—not simply Google ratings.

### My top Brisbane shortlist

| Rank | Lawyer / firm | Why I’d consider them |
|---|---|---|
| **1** | **Wendy Nixson / Sarah Vallance — Oak Medical Law** | Both are in the **2026 Doyle’s Guide “Preeminent”** tier for Queensland plaintiff medical-negligence lawyers. Oak is a specialist medical-law practice rather than a general injury firm. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-queensland/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.bestlawyers.com](https://www.bestlawyers.com/australia/medical-negligence?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **2** | **Kirsten Van Der Wal — Maurice Blackburn** | Probably the strongest individual name on the list. She has practised **exclusively in medical negligence** throughout her career, leads Maurice Blackburn's QLD/NT medical-negligence practice, and has acted in Supreme Court, Court of Appeal and High Court litigation. She is also **Best Lawyers-recognised** and Doyle's 2026 Preeminent. [www.mauriceblackburn.com.au](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/our-lawyers/kirsten-van-der-wal/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **3** | **Kate Avery — Kare Lawyers** | Doyle's 2026 **Leading** Queensland medical-negligence lawyer. A good option if you want a smaller specialist compensation practice rather than a large national firm. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-queensland/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.bestlawyers.com](https://www.bestlawyers.com/australia/medical-negligence?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **4** | **Renee Davidson / Terry McCormick — McInnes Wilson** | McInnes Wilson has substantial medical-negligence expertise. Terry McCormick has been recognised by Best Lawyers for medical negligence since 2020; Renee Davidson is in Doyle's 2026 Leading tier. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-queensland/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.bestlawyers.com](https://www.bestlawyers.com/australia/medical-negligence?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |
| **5** | **Chloe Heterick — Slater & Gordon** | Doyle's 2026 **Recommended** tier. Slater & Gordon has a dedicated Brisbane medical-negligence practice and substantial Queensland infrastructure. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/medical-negligence-compensation-lawyers-plaintiff-queensland/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) |


### A couple of other firms worth getting quotes from

**Gain Lawyers** is interesting if you particularly want a **Queensland Law Society Accredited Specialist** leading the matter. Its principal, Jeremy Roche, has 23+ years' personal-injury experience and the firm specifically handles medical negligence, including misdiagnosis, surgical errors, medication errors and birth injuries. [www.gainlawyers.com.au](https://www.gainlawyers.com.au/medical-negligence/brisbane?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Oak Medical Law is especially worth investigating if your matter is genuinely complex medical litigation. Its Brisbane practice is specifically focused on medical negligence and related medical-law matters.

Maurice Blackburn Personal Injury Lawyers Brisbane City is the other firm I'd put very high on the list because of Kirsten Van Der Wal's specialist credentials and litigation record. [www.mauriceblackburn.com.au](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/our-lawyers/kirsten-van-der-wal/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

McInnes Wilson Lawyers is another strong choice, particularly for a technically complicated claim requiring substantial expert evidence.

### If it were my case

I'd get **2–3 initial assessments**, rather than choosing solely from a ranking. Medical negligence cases can turn heavily on **causation and expert medical evidence**, and the best lawyer for a surgical error may not be the best lawyer for, say, a delayed cancer diagnosis or birth injury. Gain Lawyers itself highlights causation as one of the hardest parts of these claims. [www.gainlawyers.com.au](https://www.gainlawyers.com.au/medical-negligence/brisbane?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I'd start with:

1. **Oak Medical Law**
2. **Kirsten Van Der Wal / Maurice Blackburn**
3. **McInnes Wilson**

Then compare **who will personally run the case, their experience with cases like yours, proposed fee arrangement, expert-evidence costs, and their assessment of the prospects**.

**Important:** Queensland medical-negligence claims have specific procedural requirements and limitation issues, so don't delay getting advice if the treatment occurred some time ago. [www.enlightlawyers.com.au](https://www.enlightlawyers.com.au/practice-areas/personal-areas-of-law/medical-negligence?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **what type of medical negligence you're dealing with** (e.g. misdiagnosis, surgery, hospital negligence, birth injury, medication error, delayed treatment, cosmetic surgery), I can narrow this down to the **3 best Brisbane lawyers for that particular type of case**, including their recent case experience and fees/no-win-no-fee arrangements.

### A couple of other firms worth getting quotes from

**Gain Lawyers** is interesting if you particularly want a **Queensland Law Society Accredited Specialist** leading the matter. Its principal, Jeremy Roche, has 23+ years' personal-injury experience and the firm specifically handles medical negligence, including misdiagnosis, surgical errors, medication errors and birth injuries. [www.gainlawyers.com.au](https://www.gainlawyers.com.au/medical-negligence/brisbane?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Oak Medical Law is especially worth investigating if your matter is genuinely complex medical litigation. Its Brisbane practice is specifically focused on medical negligence and related medical-law matters.

Maurice Blackburn Personal Injury Lawyers Brisbane City is the other firm I'd put very high on the list because of Kirsten Van Der Wal's specialist credentials and litigation record. [www.mauriceblackburn.com.au](https://www.mauriceblackburn.com.au/our-lawyers/kirsten-van-der-wal/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

McInnes Wilson Lawyers is another strong choice, particularly for a technically complicated claim requiring substantial expert evidence.

### If it were my case

I'd get **2–3 initial assessments**, rather than choosing solely from a ranking. Medical negligence cases can turn heavily on **causation and expert medical evidence**, and the best lawyer for a surgical error may not be the best lawyer for, say, a delayed cancer diagnosis or birth injury. Gain Lawyers itself highlights causation as one of the hardest parts of these claims. [www.gainlawyers.com.au](https://www.gainlawyers.com.au/medical-negligence/brisbane?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I'd start with:

1. **Oak Medical Law**
2. **Kirsten Van Der Wal / Maurice Blackburn**
3. **McInnes Wilson**

Then compare **who will personally run the case, their experience with cases like yours, proposed fee arrangement, expert-evidence costs, and their assessment of the prospects**.

**Important:** Queensland medical-negligence claims have specific procedural requirements and limitation issues, so don't delay getting advice if the treatment occurred some time ago. [www.enlightlawyers.com.au](https://www.enlightlawyers.com.au/practice-areas/personal-areas-of-law/medical-negligence?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
